title: The AI Nutrition Companion for GLP-1 Patients: Inside Kevin Minn's Journey Building Nourished By Mira
summary: The AI Nutrition Companion for GLP-1 Patients: Inside Kevin Minn's Journey Building Nourished By Mira
body_markdown:
GLP-1 drugs have moved into the mainstream, with[11% of US adults](https://www.ktvu.com/news/heres-how-many-americans-say-now-taking-glp-1-drugs) now taking one for weight loss. And the shift is evident far beyond the pharmacy. Grocery stores are now promoting GLP-1 diets and setting aside dedicated meal plans for people on the medication.


But for patients navigating side effects like nausea and lost appetite, the medication doesn’t tell patients what to eat. Often, as a patient’s appetite drops,[their protein intake decreases with it](https://nourishedbymira.com/blog/glp1-muscle-loss) , resulting in a loss of lean mass as well as fat.


When two of his friends began suffering from GLP-1 side effects, developer and founder[Kevin Minn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kevin-minn/) went looking for something that could provide them with nutritional guidance for low appetite periods. He couldn’t find one, and quickly realized that the AI recipe app he was already building could be adapted to help his friends and other patients like them. So he pivoted to build Nourished by Mira, an AI nutrition companion for GLP-1 patients.


## Introducing Nourished by Mira: An AI Companion That Checks In First


Nourished by Mira is a body composition-first nutrition app that adapts meals, grocery lists, and daily guidance to each user’s appetite, symptoms, goals, and training schedule.


Most nutrition apps leave the work to the user, asking them to input what they’ve eaten and then analyzing dietary trends. Nourished by Mira is taking a different approach. Instead of waiting for users to input meals, Mira reaches out to users on dose days, when side effects peak, asks how they're feeling, and adjusts their plan to match.


“Rather than telling people to take note of what they eat, Mira’s approach comes from the caring side,” Kevin explains. “The app checks in on users on their dose days, not the other way around. If they’re having nausea or have no appetite, it might suggest portions to match, or something small that still gets protein in, like a shake or Greek yogurt. It depends on how the user is doing.”


Mira also goes beyond meals. A strength section helps users protect lean mass, hair shedding education explains a side effect many patients don’t see coming, and a prescriber report lets patients share their progress with their care team.


## Kevin’s Journey to Nourished by Mira


Nourished by Mira sits in the middle of one of the biggest shifts in medicine in decades, but Kevin himself doesn’t come from a medical background.


Kevin originally set out to build a simple grocery list app for himself, designed to nudge him before he left the store because he kept forgetting items on his list. As a keen baker, he began incorporating AI-generated recipes from around the world into the platform, and the grocery list app soon evolved into an AI recipe app.


It wasn’t until two friends started taking GLP-1 medications and began suffering from the side effects that Kevin saw that the app could help more people than just him. He couldn’t find any apps that would advise GLP-1 patients around their dose days, when the side effects are at their worst. "I already had this app going,” he explains, “so I thought, maybe I'll just do something for them and see how that goes."


As he pivoted, Kevin’s mission of care for his friends also shaped his product decisions. Nourished by Mira is now live on the App Store and growing organically, with paying subscribers in the US, the UK, and Australia, plus early adoption in Saudi Arabia and beyond.


## Kevin’s Advice for Fellow Founders


Though Kevin has been building Mira alone thus far, he recognizes the importance of having a co-founder. "I'm a designer, I'm an architect, I'm a coder. I do everything by myself today,” he explains. But that also means Kevin has no one to stress-test his ideas with. "In my head, it's always a good idea, but that doesn't necessarily mean it's going to be good," he says.


Finding a co-founder who matches his working style and complements his abilities takes time, Kevin explains. “But I think it’s essential.” Until then, the people Mira was built for keep him honest, starting with the two friends who inspired it.


And as Kevin scales Mira, Every is there to support him at each stage of growth. “Every’s platform is so streamlined,” he says. “I'm trying to make this company take off, and Every has everything I need to scale, packaged together.”


To learn more about Kevin’s journey building Mira, you can[follow him on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kevin-minn/) and visit[nourishedbymira.com](http://nourishedbymira.com/) .
